title: Deutschlandstipendium

provider.name: Federal Government and participating German universities

summary: A public-private scholarship for high-achieving and committed students at participating German universities, awarded independently of nationality and family income.

degree_levels.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

subject_areas.notes: The official federal FAQ explicitly accepts all subject areas at participating institutions.

values: Participating public or state-recognised universities in Germany
institutions.notes: The national programme requires a participating institution; individual selection rules and deadlines are set by that university.

nationality.notes: The official source explicitly welcomes first- and higher-semester students of all nationalities.

residence.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

mandatory.text: Meet the requirements of the participating university's own selection process.
The federal FAQ excludes doctoral candidates, students at federal universities, and administrative-university students receiving trainee remuneration.
Other merit-based material scholarships averaging EUR 30/month or more generally prevent simultaneous receipt; consult the provider's detailed exceptions and university rules.

preferences.text: Academic achievement, social commitment, personal achievements and overcoming social or family obstacles are considered.

funding.description: EUR 300 per month, funded equally by the Federal Government and private sponsors. Personal and parental income do not determine the award.
funding.duration: Normally at least two semesters; up to the standard study period, subject to university review and continued private funding.

application_rounds.notes: No confirmed application dates were established.

recurring_deadline_notes: There is no single national deadline. Apply directly to the participating university within its local application period.

steps.text: Find a participating university using the official map.
Check that university's requirements, selection rules and current call.

sources.title: The Deutschlandstipendium: What you need to know about the German public-private scholarship - BMFTR Deutschlandstipendium
sources.notes: The official source describes funding for international students studying in Germany.
